title: Seeking connection?
content: I’m wondering how many of us have a mental health diagnoses. ADDITIONALLY, how many smoke weed? I personally have adhd, c-ptsd, and anxiety. I’ve had it since I was a child and I’ve always had vivid dreams, especially mall world dreams. Every night. The world and the dreams have evolved over time but I always go to the same place and I’m partially if not fully lucid. For the cannabis portion of my curiosities - I myself partake and have for many years. I have good friends that say that cannabis use makes them not dream at all. I’m just curious on what you guys think? And I want to be clear that I am open to all prospectives and support mental health in all capacities. This is a safe space!
